asset_type: TaraHome blog cover and library card for replacing one Home Assistant endpoint without rebuilding its automations
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: TaraHome blog cover
Primary request: a homeowner carefully replacing one small unbranded smart plug without disturbing the rest of a working smart home
Scene/backdrop: warm, lived-in residential living room with an oak side table, cream plaster wall, linen upholstery, and one restrained dark-green cushion; practical and calm, not luxury staging
Subject: natural adult hands at a real wall outlet, one hand removing a slightly older compact white smart plug while a clean replacement smart plug rests close by on the oak table; a simple unbranded motion sensor and lamp remain in place in the room to suggest existing automations continuing to work
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial home photography with believable hardware, accurate outlet geometry, natural skin and fabric texture, subtle everyday imperfections
Composition/framing: wide horizontal blog-cover composition, medium close-up at seated eye level, the plug replacement action clearly centered so it survives a landscape article-card crop; no intentional empty headline area
Lighting/mood: soft late-morning window light, warm neutral color balance, gentle realistic shadows, reassuring practical mood
Color palette: natural oak, warm white, linen beige, restrained dark green accents
Constraints: no brand names, no logos, no text, no watermark; no embedded headline or title poster; no screen interface; no chart, graph, diagram, route line, network path, decorative connection line, translucent panel, inset frame, floating UI card, progress bar, or floating device; no invented futuristic hardware; no repeated beige device-diagram look; all objects must sit naturally in the physical scene; keep fingers, plug prongs, outlet, and device proportions anatomically and mechanically plausible
Output intent: unique topic-specific editorial cover for an article about safely replacing a Home Assistant device without rebuilding automations
